title: AIOS Dispatch Brief v1
description: Self-contained packet a subagent works from when it starts with a fresh context window. Owner: scripts/lib/foundation/agents/brief/index.mjs — do not hand-edit field lists anywhere else.

ownedPathPrefixes.description: Workspace-relative path prefixes this worker may write. Empty means read-only.

acceptance.description: How the work will be judged. Empty means the worker states its own verification.

forbidden.description: Rules the worker must not violate; defaults forbid inheriting the parent conversation.

outputSchema.description: Repo-relative path to the JSON schema the handoff must satisfy.
